title: Credit for an Earlier Functional Capacity Evaluation Attempt
content:
# Credit for an earlier evaluation attempt

*Evaluator questions and answers — Functional Capacity Evaluation, Workers' Compensation Referral.*

**What is the partial-attempt credit?** Evaluation hours already recorded on the referral are credited against a new authorization request. The partial-attempt credit takes off the evaluation hours already recorded on the referral, hour for hour, where the latest recorded evaluation day is no more than seven (7) calendar days before the request; half of those hours, rounded down, where it is eight to thirty (8 to 30) days before; and nothing otherwise, the results of an older attempt being retested in full.

**Which hours count?** All evaluation hours recorded on the referral to date.

**From which day is the age counted?** From the date of service of the latest evaluation day recorded on the referral, in calendar days to the day of the request.

**Bands.**

| Latest recorded evaluation day, before the request | Credit taken off |
|---|---|
| 0 to 7 calendar days | every evaluation hour already recorded |
| 8 to 30 calendar days | half of those hours, rounded down |
| more than 30 calendar days, or no evaluation day recorded | nothing; an older attempt is retested in full |

**Worked cases (hypothetical, 3 evaluation hours already recorded).**

| Latest recorded evaluation day | Credit |
|---|---|
| 5 days before the request | 3 hours |
| 7 days before | 3 hours |
| 8 days before | half of 3 is 1.5, rounded down to 1 hour |
| 30 days before | 1 hour |
| 31 days before | nothing |
